Presenting the first video song "Tum Hi Aana" from the upcoming Bollywood movie . This romantic track is sung by Jubin Nautiyal and the music is composed by Payal Dev. The film is starring Riteish Deshmukh, Sidharth Malhotra, Tara Sutaria and Rakul Preet Singh. The movie is directed by Milap Zaveri and is produced by Bhushan Kumar, Divya Khosla Kumar, Krishan Kumar (T-Series) and Monisha Advani, Madhu Bhojwani and Nikkhil Advani (Emmay Entertainment).
Marjaavaan releasing on 15th November 2019
